$comment: Seed corpus for the walras demo catalog and the search evaluation harness. Single source of truth: demo/seller.ts builds its route config from these entries (stock declareDiscoveryExtension), demo/seed-catalog.ts pays each route through walras so the LIVE catalog is populated by real settlements (gate G4.1), and eval/search/run.mjs builds an identical fixture catalog through the same indexer trust boundary. Eleven resources in four deliberately overlapping vocabulary clusters (weather/air, finance/markets, geo/network, language) so that ranking between near-neighbours is non-trivial. Field constraints mirror the soft-drop rules the indexer enforces (FACTS F-031): serviceName <= 32 printable ASCII chars, <= 5 tags of <= 32 chars each.

resources.description: Current weather conditions for any city right now: temperature, sky condition, wind speed, and humidity.

city.description: City name to report the current weather for, for example Zurich or Mumbai

units.description: Unit system for temperature and wind speed: metric for Celsius, imperial for Fahrenheit

resources.description: Historical daily weather for a city on a past date: recorded high and low temperature, precipitation, and snowfall.

city.description: City to fetch the historical weather record for

date.description: Calendar day to look up as ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD, up to ten years back

resources.description: Air quality index for a city: AQI value, dominant pollutant, and PM2.5, PM10, and ozone concentrations.

city.description: City to measure air quality in

resources.description: Mid-market foreign exchange rate between two fiat currencies, refreshed every minute.

base.description: Base fiat currency as an ISO 4217 code, for example USD

quote.description: Quote fiat currency as an ISO 4217 code, for example EUR

resources.description: Delayed stock market quote for a listed company: last trade price, day change percent, and trading volume.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol of the listed company, for example AAPL or TSLA

resources.description: Spot price for a cryptocurrency in a chosen fiat currency, with the 24-hour change.

symbol.description: Cryptocurrency ticker symbol, for example BTC, ETH, or XLM

fiat.description: Fiat currency for the quoted price as an ISO 4217 code, defaults to USD

resources.description: Forward geocoding: turn a street address or place name into latitude and longitude coordinates.

address.description: Free-form postal address or place name to geocode

resources.description: Reverse geocoding: turn latitude and longitude coordinates back into the nearest street address.
IP address intelligence: approximate geolocation, autonomous system number, ISP name, and VPN or proxy flags.

ip.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address to look up

resources.description: Sentiment analysis for a short text: positive, negative, or neutral label with a confidence score.

exampleInput.text: The settlement was fast and the fees were tiny.

text.description: Text to classify, up to two thousand characters; works best on a sentence or short paragraph

resources.description: Machine translation of text between languages; detects the source language automatically.

target.description: Target language as a BCP 47 code, for example de or ja
